course_summary:
ISEN 615 | Production and Inventory Control | Summer 2026
Instructor: Alaa Elwany | elwany@tamu.edu
Grading: Exam [25%], Exam [25%], Exam [25%], Exam [25%] — A: 90-100, B: 80-90, C: 70-80, D: 50-70, F: 0-50
Topics: line balancing, dispatching, releasing, kitting, flexible manufacturing, assembly, certain/uncertain demand, push production systems, pull production systems, deterministic operations scheduling problems, basic project scheduling problems, production control models, MRP and Lot Sizing, just-in-time, MRP, lot sizing, inventory control systems, aggregate production and supply chain planning, operations management problems, production function, decision making in a production system, analytical methods, Model development, inventory management, production planning, scheduling, Forecasting, Aggregate Planning, Deterministic Inventory, Stochastic Inventory, Operations Scheduling, Project Scheduling
Prerequisites: ISEN 620; ISEN 609
